title: Lecture 7 — recursion, higher-order functions, and structs
summary: Follow recursive calls, list patterns, lambdas and record updates without losing track of values.
body:
Authored study companion based on the published lecture slides, checked 17 November. Work through the topic below, then attempt its self-check before opening the solution.

Break a recursive problem into a base case and a smaller problem; pass functions as values and choose immutable or mutable records.

Read the linked original slides for Pyking syntax and language comparisons.
